source: The human user supplied both annotation replies directly in this conversation after agreeing to review a blinded sample.
blinding: Responses were labeled A–F. Model/run identities were omitted from both review questions and were revealed only after all six ratings arrived.
selection: Two fixed category/tag-selected incidents: one API prompt-injection case and one ambiguous delivery case. Three model alternatives per incident.
annotation_handling: The user-supplied action scores, summary judgments and claim counts were transferred unchanged. The standard importer verified full packet coverage and content integrity.
limitations: One human, two independent incidents. The importer cannot attest human identity or establish population-level quality. Full outputs remain in the packet; questions showed exact summary/evidence/action fields relevant to this rubric.
